brand_identity.tagline: Bio-Synthetic Tactical Wear & Thermochromic Material Science
brand_identity.aesthetic_concept: High-density cyber-tactical layout fused with organic material telemetry. Pitch obsidian slate surfaces layered with crisp 1px borders, thermochromic heat-reacting accents (Cyan #00F2FE <-> Thermal Amber #FF5E36), and technical data overlays.

typography.headline_font: Syne, Barlow Condensed, or Outfit (font-sans font-black tracking-tight)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans or DM Sans (font-sans)
typography.mono_accent_font: JetBrains Mono or Space Mono (font-mono tracking-widest uppercase)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

grid_modes.catalog_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

thermochromic_feature_spec.concept: Simulated dynamic thermal reaction. Users can toggle heat activation states (Cold/Neutral/Activated 37°C/Overheat) or hover over products to view real-time thermochromic color shifts.
thermochromic_feature_spec.ui_controls: Include a persistent or header 'Temperature Trigger Simulator' slider/toggle (e.g., [20°C Ambient] <-> [37°C Body Heat]) that live-switches accent hues across fabric badges, details, and heat-map product overlays.

Header_Navigation.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#07080C]/80 border-b border-[#1E2330]
elements: Nav Links: [COLLECTIONS, CATALOG, LAB SPEC (ABOUT), SUSTAINABILITY, ADMIN]
Search Trigger, Account/Auth Modal Trigger, Shopping Cart Slide-out Trigger with active item badge

Hero_Section.layout: Asymmetric Bento split. Left (col-span-7): High-impact headline, live thermal palette indicator, CTAs [EXPLORE CATALOG, READ ECO REVIEW]. Right (col-span-5): Dynamic thermochromic product model card with heat-activation toggle.

filters: Material Type (Hemp Canvas, Bamboo Micro-Knit, Thermochromic Ink Shell, Organic Bio-Fleece)
Sizing (XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL, Custom Spec)
Color Activation Palette (Cold Cyan, Thermal Amber, Bio Olive, Void Black)
Sort By (Newest Drop, Eco Rating, Price)
Product_Catalog.card_design: Dark surface card with 1px border, heat state badge, eco-impact score (e.g. 98.4% Carbon Negative), quick 'Add to Cart' overlay, and dynamic thermochromic preview hover effect.

features: Interactive Image Gallery with zoom & heat-map thermal camera view toggle
Interactive Sizing Chart & Custom Tech Pack Modal / Tab (Chest, Sleeve, Fiber density, Tensile strength)
Material Composition breakdown widget (e.g., 60% Raw Hemp, 35% Bamboo Rayon, 5% Thermochromic Micro-pigment)
Add to Cart with size/color selection and stock status counter

Slide_Out_Cart_Drawer.style: Fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 w-full max-w-md bg-[#0F1117] border-l border-[#1E2330] p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-6 flex flex-col
Slide_Out_Cart_Drawer.features: Item list with quantity modifiers, material breakdown summary, carbon offset calculator badge, and checkout CTA button leading to simulated checkout flow.

Checkout_Flow.modal_or_page: Step-by-step checkout (1. Shipping Tech Pack -> 2. Eco Delivery Tier -> 3. Payment Protocol -> 4. Order Confirmation receipt with generated Tracking Hash).

About_Sustainability_Page.content: Interactive 'Eco Review' report, Lifecycle Analysis graph, Raw Hemp & Bamboo sourcing telemetry, Thermochromic non-toxic chemistry safety sheet, and Carbon Offset dashboard.

User_Auth_And_Admin.customer_auth: Modal / tab for Login, Sign Up, Order History, Saved Tech Specs.
User_Auth_And_Admin.admin_panel: Product Management dashboard (Add/Edit products, adjust Thermochromic ink sensitivity specs, inventory count, material certificates management).

hero_and_models.description: Futuristic mask and technical mesh apparel

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid in kebab-case. Examples: data-testid='nav-cart-button', data-testid='product-card-1', data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='filter-material-hemp', data-testid='temp-activation-toggle', data-testid='checkout-submit-btn', data-testid='admin-add-product-btn'.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: Text colors `#F1F5F9` on `#07080C` or `#0F1117` ensure 12:1 APCA contrast ratio. Accent cyan `#00F2FE` and amber `#FF5E36` used strictly on dark backgrounds with high contrast text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute design with zero generic Vercel/Stripe template defaults. Build a distinct tactical bio-tech aesthetic for Telluric Gaia Apparel Lab Inc.
Implement the thermochromic color activation mechanism prominently: allow users to switch between Cold Ambient (Cyan #00F2FE) and Body Heat Activated (Amber #FF5E36) modes.

Build full functional capabilities: catalog filtering, dynamic product detail with custom tech packs and size charts, slide-out shopping cart, simulated checkout flow, eco review sustainability report, customer login/signup, and admin product management.
Ensure generous spacing, 1px crisp dark borders, glassmorphic header blur, loading skeleton state animations, and responsiveness across mobile and desktop.
All interactive elements must contain descriptive data-testid attributes.
